summary: Raised the cryptography pin in pyproject.toml from 42.0.0 to 42.0.4; the loop regenerates uv.lock.

files.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "hello"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["cryptography==42.0.4"]

# The tests build stand-in wheels into wheels/ and resolve from there only, so
# uv lock and uv sync need no network.
[tool.uv]
package = false
no-index = true
find-links = ["wheels"]
